about: Projects by voice (Lane B of Will's plan of 3 Nov 2026: "Open the leaf one from last week." "What Projects do I have on guard cells?" "Tidy this Project" ... "Archive the old test ones." "Everything undoable."). The stack's fresh home is seeded with Will's kind of Projects (`projects`, stack.seed_projects, dated from the run's day): a leaf one last week, an older leaf one, a guard-cell one, an onion one whose conversation was about guard cells, and two test runs. Played as the camera; no setup.
